canonical_project: Viridis Green Data Centres Burnie edge data centre
owner: VIRIDIS Green Data Centres (landlord: Arcana Capital)
notes: Tier III Zone 4 edge data centre in Burnie CBD (former Advocate newspaper print centre); ~1MW draw from existing grid connection, 1,215 sqm, free-air cooling plus staged solar/battery/hydrogen clean-burn microgrid. Burnie City Council issued the permit under s.51/s.57 Land Use Planning and Approvals Act 1993 (Clause 6.8 Tasmanian Planning Scheme) as Storage Use (Data Centre), no conditions; target go-live H1 2027. Capacity basis: ~1MW grid draw, not IT load.
